name: branda_cigolio
text: an old wooden camp cot creaking as someone slowly sits up on it in a quiet dark room, canvas and wood strain, close, no music

name: respiro_risveglio
text: one slow deep breath of an old woman waking up, a tired inhale and a soft exhale, very close, quiet room, no music

name: generatore_attutito
text: a slow heavy mechanical heartbeat of a big iron engine heard muffled through thick wooden walls and curtains, deep low thump every second, steady, no music

name: generatore_fuori
text: a large iron engine with visible pistons beating like a heart outdoors, rhythmic deep mechanical thump and hiss, faster, steady, open air, no music

name: fruscio_tende
text: heavy dark cloth curtains brushing and swishing as someone walks through them, soft, close, no music

name: lanterna_apre
text: a small iron lantern shutter sliding open with a metallic click and a soft whoosh of a flame growing brighter, no music

name: lanterna_chiude
text: a small iron lantern shutter sliding closed with a firm metallic clack, the flame muffled, no music

name: fiamma_ronzio
text: the soft steady hum and gentle crackle of a small oil lantern flame, very quiet, intimate, no music

name: porta_camion_vento
text: a heavy wooden door of a big truck swinging open with a creak, then cold wind rushing in over an open plain, no music

name: passo_erba
text: a single footstep of a boot on dry crunchy grass, short, no music

name: passo_brina
text: a single footstep of a boot crunching on thin frost and frozen ground, short, crisp, no music

name: salto
text: a quick jump, cloth of a coat flapping and a short effort breath of an old woman, no music

name: atterraggio
text: landing on dry ground after a small jump, boots thud with a little scrape of gravel, no music

name: presa_arrampicata
text: hands grabbing a wooden ledge and pulling a body up, wood creak, cloth rustle and a grunt of effort, no music

name: bastone_legno
text: a heavy wooden staff striking a wooden plank with a solid dull knock, no music

name: bastone_ghiaccio
text: a heavy wooden staff striking a crust of ice, sharp crack with small ice shards falling, no music

name: bastone_creatura
text: a wooden staff hitting a small hard shelled creature covered in frost, a dull crunchy thwack, no music

name: arbusto_spezza
text: a dry frozen bush snapping and breaking apart, brittle twigs cracking, no music

name: crosta_spezza
text: a thick crust of ice breaking and shattering into pieces on metal, crisp, no music

name: coda_libera
text: a long metal tube pulled free from ice with a deep metallic groan and a scrape, then it clanks loose, no music

name: sciame_zampettio
text: a small swarm of fist sized insect-like creatures skittering over frozen ground, many tiny clicking legs, approaching, no music

name: brinacchio_sconfitto
text: a small frosty creature defeated, a short crackle of breaking frost shell and a tiny squeak, no music

name: respiro_affannato
text: an old woman out of breath after running, heavy panting, three or four breaths, no music

name: corda_nodo
text: a thick rope being pulled tight into a knot, fibres creaking and a final tug, no music

name: brusio_folla
text: a crowd of many people of all ages packing up a camp outdoors at sunset, indistinct murmur, distant calls, wooden crates moved, no clear words, no music

name: tromba_gnomone
text: a man calling through an old brass speaking trumpet, a short metallic resonant bark, far away across a camp, no clear words, no music

name: colpo_subito_ottavia
text: an old woman hit by a small creature, a short pained grunt with a cloth thump, no music
